_comment: Disease & condition library for Health_DiseaseSystem.js. Generated by gen_diseases.py. transmission is per-exposure probability (0..1); venereal diseases only spread through romantic/sexual relations. onset.steps = steps carried before onset.stateId is applied (0 = none). kind/epidemic/cfr/r0/rarity drive the epidemic engine: kind hysteria = socially transmitted panic, not a pathogen.

diseases.name: Influenza
diseases.desc: Seasonal flu virus. Fever, aches, and a week of misery.

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.desc: Rhinovirus. Runny nose, mild but relentlessly contagious.

diseases.name: Novel Coronavirus
diseases.desc: A pandemic respiratory virus with a stubborn viral load.

diseases.name: Measles
diseases.desc: Extraordinarily contagious. Koplik spots and a blanketing rash.

diseases.name: Mumps
diseases.desc: Paramyxovirus swelling the parotid glands.

diseases.name: Rubella
diseases.desc: German measles. Mild in adults, dangerous in pregnancy.

diseases.name: Chickenpox
diseases.desc: Varicella-zoster. Itching crops of blisters everywhere.

diseases.name: Shingles
diseases.desc: Reactivated varicella tracing a nerve in searing pain.

diseases.name: Mononucleosis
diseases.desc: The kissing disease. Epstein-Barr leaves you flattened for weeks.

diseases.name: Hepatitis A
diseases.desc: Fecal-oral liver virus. Jaundice and exhaustion.

diseases.name: Hepatitis B
diseases.desc: Bloodborne and sexual. Chronic liver inflammation.

diseases.name: Hepatitis C
diseases.desc: Silent bloodborne virus scarring the liver over decades.

diseases.name: Norovirus
diseases.desc: Winter vomiting bug. Explosive and absurdly contagious.

diseases.name: Rotavirus
diseases.desc: Severe gastroenteritis, dehydrating and swift.

diseases.name: Rabies
diseases.desc: Once symptomatic, near-universally fatal. Hydrophobia and fury.

diseases.name: Poliomyelitis
diseases.desc: Attacks motor neurons; can leave permanent paralysis.

diseases.name: Smallpox
diseases.desc: Eradicated in life, resurgent in nightmares. Pustular and deadly.

diseases.name: Ebola
diseases.desc: Hemorrhagic fever. The body unmakes itself from within.

diseases.name: Dengue Fever
diseases.desc: Breakbone fever carried by mosquitoes.

diseases.name: Yellow Fever
diseases.desc: Mosquito-borne hemorrhagic fever with jaundice.

diseases.name: Zika Virus
diseases.desc: Usually mild, dangerous in pregnancy. Also sexually transmissible.

diseases.name: West Nile Virus
diseases.desc: Mosquito-borne; occasionally neuroinvasive.

diseases.name: Hantavirus
diseases.desc: Rodent-borne pulmonary syndrome. Drowning on dry land.

diseases.name: HIV
diseases.desc: Retrovirus dismantling the immune system over years.

diseases.name: Herpes Simplex
diseases.desc: Lifelong latent virus; periodic cold-sore or genital flares.

diseases.name: Human Papillomavirus
diseases.desc: Common venereal virus; some strains oncogenic.

diseases.name: Cytomegalovirus
diseases.desc: Ubiquitous herpesvirus, dangerous only to the immunocompromised.

diseases.name: Strep Throat
diseases.desc: Streptococcus pyogenes inflaming the throat.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis
diseases.desc: Consumption. A slow, coughing wasting of the lungs.

diseases.name: Bacterial Pneumonia
diseases.desc: Lungs filling with inflammatory fluid.

diseases.name: Cholera
diseases.desc: Rice-water diarrhea that can kill by dehydration in a day.

diseases.name: Typhoid Fever
diseases.desc: Salmonella typhi. Sustained fever and rose spots.

diseases.name: Bubonic Plague
diseases.desc: The Black Death. Buboes, fever, and blackened extremities.

diseases.name: Tetanus
diseases.desc: Lockjaw. Neurotoxin locking every muscle rigid.

diseases.name: Leprosy
diseases.desc: Hansen's disease numbing nerves and disfiguring slowly.

diseases.name: Lyme Disease
diseases.desc: Tick-borne; a bullseye rash then joint and nerve grief.

diseases.name: Bacterial Meningitis
diseases.desc: Inflamed meninges. Stiff neck, photophobia, and speed kills.

diseases.name: Gonorrhea
diseases.desc: The clap. Purulent venereal infection.

diseases.name: Chlamydia
diseases.desc: Often silent venereal infection; a leading cause of infertility.

diseases.name: Syphilis
diseases.desc: The great imitator; untreated it climbs to the brain.

diseases.name: Botulism
diseases.desc: The most potent toxin known; descending paralysis.

diseases.name: MRSA
diseases.desc: Methicillin-resistant staph. Antibiotics fail.

diseases.name: Scarlet Fever
diseases.desc: Strep with a sandpaper rash and strawberry tongue.

diseases.name: Whooping Cough
diseases.desc: Pertussis. Paroxysmal coughing fits ending in a whoop.

diseases.name: Gangrene
diseases.desc: Tissue death spreading from a wound; smells of rot.

diseases.name: Sepsis
diseases.desc: The body's response to infection turning on itself.

diseases.name: Ringworm
diseases.desc: Dermatophyte fungus in expanding itchy rings.

diseases.name: Athlete's Foot
diseases.desc: Tinea pedis. Itching, peeling, contagious feet.

diseases.name: Candidiasis
diseases.desc: Yeast overgrowth; thrush or genital infection.

diseases.name: Aspergillosis
diseases.desc: Mold colonizing the lungs of the vulnerable.

diseases.name: Valley Fever
diseases.desc: Coccidioidomycosis from inhaled desert spores.

diseases.name: Cryptococcosis
diseases.desc: Fungal meningitis, chiefly in the immunocompromised.

diseases.name: Black Mold Sickness
diseases.desc: Chronic mycotoxin exposure fogging body and mind.

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.desc: Plasmodium cycling through the blood in fevered waves.

diseases.name: Toxoplasmosis
diseases.desc: Cat-borne protozoan; may nudge behavior and risk-taking.

diseases.name: Giardiasis
diseases.desc: Beaver fever. Greasy diarrhea from contaminated water.

diseases.name: Amoebic Dysentery
diseases.desc: Entamoeba eating through the gut wall.

diseases.name: Chagas Disease
diseases.desc: Kissing-bug trypanosome that decades later wrecks the heart.

diseases.name: African Sleeping Sickness
diseases.desc: Tsetse trypanosome invading the brain; sleep inverts and fails.

diseases.name: Leishmaniasis
diseases.desc: Sandfly protozoan; disfiguring sores or organ disease.

diseases.name: Tapeworm
diseases.desc: A segmented guest in the gut, quietly taking your meals.

diseases.name: Hookworm
diseases.desc: Soil-borne worm draining blood from the gut wall.

diseases.name: Schistosomiasis
diseases.desc: Freshwater flukes lodging in blood vessels for years.

diseases.name: Scabies
diseases.desc: Mites burrowing under the skin; maddening night itch.

diseases.name: Head Lice
diseases.desc: Insects nesting in the hair; itchy and socially dire.

diseases.name: Lymphatic Filariasis
diseases.desc: Filarial worms blocking lymph until limbs swell grotesquely.

diseases.name: River Blindness
diseases.desc: Onchocerca microfilariae migrating to the eyes.

diseases.name: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
diseases.desc: Prions spongifying the brain; rapid, unstoppable dementia.

diseases.name: Kuru
diseases.desc: The laughing death; a prion once spread by ritual cannibalism.

diseases.name: Fatal Familial Insomnia
diseases.desc: A prion stealing sleep until the body simply stops.

diseases.name: Type 1 Diabetes
diseases.desc: Autoimmune loss of insulin; blood sugar unmoored.

diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.desc: Insulin resistance from a lifetime of strain.

diseases.name: Sickle Cell Anemia
diseases.desc: Crescent red cells jamming vessels in agonizing crises.

diseases.name: Hemophilia
diseases.desc: Blood that will not clot; a scratch becomes a danger.

diseases.name: Cystic Fibrosis
diseases.desc: Thick mucus drowning lungs and clogging the pancreas.

diseases.name: Huntington's Disease
diseases.desc: An inherited fate: chorea and decline from midlife.

diseases.name: Thalassemia
diseases.desc: Faulty hemoglobin leaving the blood chronically thin.

diseases.name: Albinism
diseases.desc: Absent pigment; skin and eyes vulnerable to light.

diseases.name: Porphyria
diseases.desc: The vampire disease: sun blisters, madness, wine-dark urine.

diseases.name: Marfan Syndrome
diseases.desc: Faulty connective tissue; long limbs and a fragile aorta.

diseases.name: Lupus
diseases.desc: The wolf. Immunity turned on the body's own tissues.

diseases.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
diseases.desc: Immune-driven joint destruction, symmetric and stiff.

diseases.name: Multiple Sclerosis
diseases.desc: The immune system stripping nerve insulation.

diseases.name: Crohn's Disease
diseases.desc: Inflammation anywhere along the gut, flaring and remitting.

diseases.name: Celiac Disease
diseases.desc: Gluten triggering an immune assault on the small bowel.

diseases.name: Psoriasis
diseases.desc: Skin cells racing to the surface in silvery plaques.

diseases.name: Graves' Disease
diseases.desc: Overdriven thyroid; racing heart and bulging eyes.

diseases.name: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis
diseases.desc: The thyroid slowly extinguished; cold and heavy.

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.desc: Airways that tighten and wheeze under trigger and strain.

diseases.name: COPD
diseases.desc: Emphysema and bronchitis stealing lung capacity for good.

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.desc: The silent pressure quietly straining heart and vessels.

diseases.name: Cardiac Arrhythmia
diseases.desc: A heart that skips, races, or stutters out of time.

diseases.name: Iron-Deficiency Anemia
diseases.desc: Too little iron; the blood carries too little air.

diseases.name: Chronic Migraine
diseases.desc: Storms of headache with aura, light, and nausea.

diseases.name: Epilepsy
diseases.desc: Electrical storms that seize the brain without warning.

diseases.name: Parkinson's Disease
diseases.desc: Dopamine fading; tremor, rigidity, and a slowing gait.

diseases.name: Alzheimer's Disease
diseases.desc: Memory unspooling as plaques choke the mind.

diseases.name: Narcolepsy
diseases.desc: Sleep intruding on waking life without permission.

diseases.name: Chronic GERD
diseases.desc: Acid climbing the esophagus night after night.

diseases.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
diseases.desc: A gut at war with itself, cramping to its own rhythm.

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcer
diseases.desc: H. pylori and acid burning a hole in the stomach lining.

diseases.name: Scurvy
diseases.desc: Vitamin C gone; collagen fails and old wounds reopen.

diseases.name: Rickets
diseases.desc: Vitamin D starvation softening and bowing the bones.

diseases.name: Beriberi
diseases.desc: Thiamine deficiency drowning nerves and heart.

diseases.name: Pellagra
diseases.desc: Niacin lack: the four D's, dermatitis to dementia to death.

diseases.name: Kwashiorkor
diseases.desc: Protein starvation swelling a hollow body.

diseases.name: Iodine-Deficiency Goiter
diseases.desc: The thyroid swelling in a hunt for missing iodine.

diseases.name: Clinical Depression
diseases.desc: A grey weight on will, energy, and joy.

diseases.name: Generalized Anxiety
diseases.desc: Alarm that never fully switches off.

diseases.name: PTSD
diseases.desc: The past ambushing the present in flashes.

diseases.name: Bipolar Disorder
diseases.desc: Tides of mania and depression on their own calendar.

diseases.name: Schizophrenia
diseases.desc: Perception and reality slipping their moorings.

diseases.name: Chronic Insomnia
diseases.desc: Sleep withheld night after grinding night.

diseases.name: OCD
diseases.desc: Intrusive thoughts answered by rituals that never satisfy.

diseases.name: Ley Rot
diseases.desc: Mana channels blackening and leaking; magic sours in the veins.

diseases.name: Mana Plague
diseases.desc: A wildfire of corrupted mana leaping between casters.

diseases.name: Aether Lung
diseases.desc: Breathing raw aether crystallizes the alveoli faintly aglow.

diseases.name: The Hollowing
diseases.desc: A slow undeath: warmth, name, and self leaching away.

diseases.name: Wendigo Hunger
diseases.desc: A gnawing that ordinary food cannot touch, and craves worse.

diseases.name: Stone Flesh
diseases.desc: Skin hardening toward statue; slow, heavy, and irreversible.

diseases.name: Whisper Fever
diseases.desc: A fever whose delirium speaks in others' voices.

diseases.name: Mirror Sickness
diseases.desc: Reflections lag, then disagree; the self doubles and frays.

diseases.name: Chronal Ague
diseases.desc: Time stutters in the body; wounds age and heal out of order.

diseases.name: Void Touch
diseases.desc: Contact with the outer dark; a cold that eats from inside.

diseases.name: Star Madness
diseases.desc: Gazing too long into deep sky invites a geometry that maddens.

diseases.name: Gray Static
diseases.desc: A signal-borne affliction fuzzing thought and vision to snow.

diseases.name: Null Syndrome
diseases.desc: The self overwritten with blanks; identity checksum fails.

diseases.name: Data Rot
diseases.desc: Corruption spreading through implanted memory and nerve-lace.

diseases.name: Dream Plague
diseases.desc: An infection carried between sleepers, harvesting rest.

diseases.name: Corpse Bloom
diseases.desc: A fungus that gardens the living toward a flowering death.

diseases.name: Iron Lung Curse
diseases.desc: Each breath rusts; the chest slowly seizes to metal.

diseases.name: Laughing Pox
diseases.desc: Pustules that itch into helpless, exhausting laughter.

diseases.name: Saint's Fire
diseases.desc: Ergotism reborn: burning limbs, gangrene, and holy visions.

diseases.name: Cocoon Blight
diseases.desc: A metamorphic infection that half-seals the host in chrysalis.

diseases.name: Great Influenza
diseases.desc: The flu that killed the young and healthy first. Drowning from the inside.

diseases.name: Epidemic Typhus
diseases.desc: Louse-borne camp fever: rash, stupor, and the smell of crowded rooms.

diseases.name: Diphtheria
diseases.desc: A grey membrane grows across the throat until breath will not pass.

diseases.name: Anthrax
diseases.desc: Spores from the soil or the mail; black eschars and a fast collapse.

diseases.name: Marburg Fever
diseases.desc: A filovirus out of a mine shaft. Bleeding from every soft tissue.

diseases.name: Nipah Encephalitis
diseases.desc: Bat-borne and brain-hungry; survivors rarely come back whole.

diseases.name: Atypical Pneumonia
diseases.desc: A new pneumonia that jumps wards faster than the paperwork.

diseases.name: Legionnaires' Disease
diseases.desc: Bred in cooling towers, breathed in by everyone downwind of one.

diseases.name: Sleeping Sickness of the Brain
diseases.desc: Sleep that deepens into statue stillness; some never surface again.

diseases.name: Dancing Fever
diseases.desc: They dance until the feet split, and cannot say why they started.

diseases.name: Genital-Stealing Witch Panic
diseases.desc: Word spreads that a handshake can steal what a man was born with. The mob believes it first and checks later.

diseases.name: Laughter Epidemic
diseases.desc: It starts in a schoolroom and closes the school; nobody finds it funny by the third week.

diseases.name: Tarantism
diseases.desc: A spider nobody saw; only music and dancing are said to draw the venom out.

diseases.name: Convent Mimicry
diseases.desc: One sister meows, then the cloister does, and no prayer stops it.

diseases.name: Phantom Gasser Panic
diseases.desc: A prowler with a sweet-smelling spray that the police never once find.

diseases.name: Fainting Sickness
diseases.desc: One faints in assembly and forty follow within the hour.

diseases.name: Windscreen Pitting Delusion
diseases.desc: The whole city inspects its windscreens and finds damage that was always there.

diseases.name: Phantom Infestation
diseases.desc: Everyone in the plant feels the bug bite. No entomologist ever finds it.

diseases.name: Satanic Panic
diseases.desc: The rumour arrives fully formed with names attached, and the names get burned.

diseases.name: Doppelganger Panic
diseases.desc: Half the district swears a neighbour has been replaced by a very good copy.

diseases.name: Name Theft Panic
diseases.desc: People stop saying their own names aloud; something is collecting them.

diseases.name: Speaking Sickness
diseases.desc: A grammar nobody was taught runs through a congregation in one evening.

diseases.name: Sleepwalking Pilgrimage
diseases.desc: The town wakes on the road out of town, all facing the same way.

diseases.name: Collective Vision
diseases.desc: Four hundred witnesses, one identical impossible thing, no photograph.

diseases.name: Number Station Compulsion
diseases.desc: Listeners start copying the broadcast down, then reading it out to each other.

conditions.name: Broken Arm
conditions.desc: A fractured arm splinted and slung; strength halved on that side.

conditions.name: Broken Leg
conditions.desc: A fractured leg in a cast; every step is negotiated.

conditions.name: Broken Rib
conditions.desc: Cracked ribs make breath and swing a wince.

conditions.name: Concussion
conditions.desc: A rung skull; thought comes slow and light stings.

conditions.name: Sprained Ankle
conditions.desc: Torn ligaments; the ankle protests weight.

conditions.name: Dislocated Shoulder
conditions.desc: Reset but tender; the arm holds nothing heavy yet.

conditions.name: Deep Laceration
conditions.desc: A stitched wound that reopens if pushed too hard.

conditions.name: Severe Burns
conditions.desc: Healing burns tighten skin and blunt every nerve.

conditions.name: Frostbite
conditions.desc: Frozen tissue, blackened at the tips, aching in the cold.

conditions.name: Whiplash
conditions.desc: A wrenched neck locking the head in careful poses.

conditions.name: Spinal Injury
conditions.desc: Damage along the spine dulling strength and speed.

conditions.name: Amputation
conditions.desc: A limb lost; balance and reach permanently changed.

conditions.name: Cataract
conditions.desc: A clouding lens dimming the world to fog.

conditions.name: Hearing Loss
conditions.desc: A silence closing in; the world loses its warnings.

conditions.name: Chronic Back Pain
conditions.desc: An old ache that colors every lift and stride.

conditions.name: Osteoarthritis
conditions.desc: Worn joints grinding stiff, worse in the cold.

conditions.name: Osteoporosis
conditions.desc: Brittle bones a hard fall could shatter.

conditions.name: Kidney Stones
conditions.desc: A grain of agony passing on its own cruel schedule.

conditions.name: Appendicitis
conditions.desc: An inflamed appendix; a surgical clock ticking.

conditions.name: Hernia
conditions.desc: A bulge that turns lifting into a gamble.

conditions.name: Gout
conditions.desc: Crystals flaring a joint into red, untouchable pain.

conditions.name: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
conditions.desc: A tiredness sleep never repays.

conditions.name: Phantom Limb Pain
conditions.desc: Pain in a limb no longer there.

conditions.name: Old Battle Scars
conditions.desc: Knotted scars that tug and ache before a storm.

conditions.name: Cybernetic Rejection
conditions.desc: Implants the flesh refuses; inflammation at every seam.

conditions.name: Mana-Burn Scars
conditions.desc: Channels seared by overcasting; magic flows rough.

conditions.name: Cursed Brand
conditions.desc: A mark burned by dark magic that never fully cools.

conditions.name: Solomon's Curse
conditions.desc: You are a ticking bomb, Em. Ninety-two percent of your memories were forged into the Lance of Memory, and what grew back in the hole they left has not stopped growing.
